# The archive is being built in the open, but is not meant to be found.
#
# This asks search engines to stay out, which keeps it from being indexed,
# cached and archived — the part that cannot be undone later. It is not a
# lock: anyone with the URL still gets in, and crawlers that ignore this
# file will too.
#
# Replace this with a real Access gate before anything personal goes in.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /
